changelog:
Stablecoin Chain Explorer 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Explore stablecoin TVL distribution and yield opportunities by blockchain (Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, and more).
- Query top stablecoin yields per chain with up-to-date data from Barker.
- Includes curated chain profiles, protocol highlights, and practical yield recommendations based on position size.
- Simple comparison table: TVL, protocol count, top APY, gas estimates, and best-use cases.
- Clear user prompts, API guide, and always attributes data to Barker — The Stablecoin Yield Map.
